load.err.engineStartPurged: Error banner at startup: the engine still does not start after the one automatic cache purge and reload; Full reset is offered.
load.engine.refreshing: Status line of the waiting screen while the page purges the site cache after the engine died at start, then reloads once.
load.err.engineStart: Serious error at startup, on the waiting screen: the engine does not start (the technical detail goes to the console).
load.tprov.win: Status line under the provisional TIC after a zoom: time window shown; {a}, {b} = ends in minutes.
load.tprov.hand: Notice when the first panel opens on the window chosen on the provisional TIC; {a}, {b} = ends in minutes.
load.tprov.keys: Screen-reader description of the provisional TIC: how to zoom and move the time axis.
load.tprov.note: Note under the title of the provisional TIC shown while the first file is being indexed; {pc} = loading percentage (number already formatted).
load.tprov.title: Title of the provisional TIC of the first file being loaded (also the chart name for screen readers); {file} = file name.
load.err.noStorage: Startup banner when the browser rejects the site's storage (Safari private window); {app} = program name.
load.engine.waiting: Notice under the drop zone while the engine is starting with files queued; {n} = number of files in the queue.
load.engine.waitingOne: Notice under the drop zone when one file is waiting for the engine.
load.engine.cancel: Button to cancel the loads waiting for the engine.
load.session.restoring: Message shown in the skeleton of the drop zone while the saved session is being restored.
load.fail.copy: Button of the startup error banner: copies the technical details (without file names) to the clipboard, to paste into a report.
load.err.engineMissing: Waiting screen at startup: the browser has no WebAssembly or the engine is missing.
load.blocked: Waiting screen at startup: the saved files database is locked by another tab; {app} = program name.
load.natInterrupted: Short notice at startup: a closed tab left the copy of a vendor file (e.g. .wiff) half done, and it was removed; {name} = name of the file to load again.
load.sulPosto: Short notice at loading: an mzML with no room for the copy in the browser is read from the user's disk; {name} = file name. Calm tone, says what to do after a reload.
load.sulRiapri: Short notice at startup: an mzML read from disk without a copy is gone after the reload; {name} = name of the file to load again. Calm tone, the file is still on the disk.
open.title: Title of the work area while the first file of the list is being read: {file} = name of the first file.
load.prog.count: Under the loading bar, after the phase: {done} = files finished, {n} = files in the load.
load.phrase.1: Joking phrase of the waiting screen (one every 5 seconds); it may contain <sub>/<sup>. Keep the same joking tone.
load.demo.error: Error under the loading boxes; {message} = name of the file that failed to download.
load.hrnote: Note under the boxes when a file is in high-resolution profile. The title in quotes is that of the guide section (help.js, entry «filegrandi»): the two texts must match.
load.hrmix.lr: Button of the note shown when low- and high-resolution files are both ticked: keeps only the low-resolution files ticked; {n} = how many low-resolution files are in the list.
load.hrmix.hr: Same note, button that keeps only the high-resolution files ticked; {n} = how many high-resolution files are in the list.
load.exp.why.blocks: Tooltip of the «Experiment» menu: infusion recognized by a fixed precursor; {n} = number of keys, {max} = maximum.
load.exp.why.method_without_lc: Tooltip of the «Experiment» menu: infusion recognized from the method with no chromatography; {n} = number of keys, {max} = maximum.
load.exp.why.name: Tooltip of the «Experiment» menu: infusion recognized from the file name; {n} = number of keys, {max} = maximum.
load.row.hr: Label of a high-resolution file in the loading table, next to the name.
load.method.mrm: «Content» line of an MRM-only .dam method; {n} = number of transitions.
load.method.scans: «Content» line of a .dam method with several scan experiments; {n} = number of experiments.
load.method.scanRange: «Content» line of a .dam method with one scan; {lo} and {hi} = ends of the mass range.
load.note.movedToDam: Note in the loading boxes; {name} = file name.
load.note.movedToData: Note in the loading boxes; {name} = file name.
load.wiffTwin: Reason in the single notice after the .wiff name (unopen.err.one) for two same-named pairs that arrived without a folder in the same load.
wiffpair.need: Notice under a loaded .wiff or .wiff.scan whose other half was not loaded; {name} = the missing file name.
wiffpair.needMany: Same notice for several pairs; {name} = the missing file names, comma separated.
wiffpair.allow: Button: lets the page read the remembered folder; {folder} = its name.
wiffpair.remembered: Notice: the missing file was seen in the remembered folder, which needs one click of permission; {name} = missing file names, {folder} = the folder name.
wiffpair.found: Status after the folder was read; {names} = the file names found, {size} = their total size such as 3 MB, {folder} = the folder name.
wiffpair.missing: Notice when the folder has no file with the wanted name; {names} = missing file names, {folder} = folder name.
wiffpair.error: Notice when reading the folder failed; {detail} = the browser's message.
load.pick.types: Description of the file type filter in the system file dialog.
load.wiffWait: Reason in the single notice after the name (unopen.err.one) of the file of the .wiff/.wiff.scan pair that arrived without the other.
load.note.hashRenamed: Note of the single notice: a file with # in its name enters with _ in place of #; {from} = name given, {to} = name in the list.
load.note.wiffMethod: Notice after loading: a .wiff file without .wiff.scan was the source of the mzML files already open (same SHA-1), so only its method was read; {name} = the .wiff, {n} = how many files, {files} = their names.
load.note.gzMemory: Notice after loading: a .mzML.gz opens the old way (everything decompressed in memory) because the browser has no piecewise OPFS space; {name} = the file, {mb} = MB of the compressed file.
load.method.drop: Text of the single field for loading the instrument method; {formats} = list of the formats read today, e.g. «.dam SCIEX».
load.method.chip: Label of the loaded method (chip with ×); {name} = file name.
load.method.remove: Accessible name of the × button of the method chip; {name} = file name.
load.dup.one: Short notice in the loading screen when a file already in the list is chosen again (same name and size). {name} = file name.
load.dup.many: Like load.dup.one, for several files together. {n} = number of files ignored.
load.cell.of: Accessible name of a cell of the loading table; {f} = file name, {col} = column name.
load.cols.shown: Checkbox label to show a column in the sample table; {name} = column name.
load.cols.rename: Name field label of a custom column; {name} = column name.
load.cols.up: Button label to move a custom column left; {name} = column name.
load.cols.down: Button label to move a custom column right; {name} = column name.
load.cols.remove: Button label to remove a custom column; {name} = column name.
load.samples.head: Count line of the sample table toolbar in the work area; {n} = files (samples) in the table.
load.table.removeAll: Toolbar button of the sample table that removes every file from the table (asks first).
load.table.removeAll.ask: Question before «Remove all files»; {n} = files in the table.
load.table.open: aria-label of the file name button in the sample table; {name} = file name.
load.hrmix.asideHr: Note under the sample table: the session is low resolution, {n} high-resolution files wait unticked.
load.hrmix.asideLr: Same note, the session is high resolution and {n} low-resolution files wait.
load.hrmix.toHr: Button of that note: closes the open files and opens the high-resolution ones (undoable).
load.many.text: Question when more than 50 data files are given at once; {n} = number of files.
load.quota.ask: Question before copying a batch bigger than the browser's storage; {n} = data files, {serve} = room needed (MB or GB), {libero} = room left, {k} = files that fit.
load.quota.first: Button: load only the first {k} files that fit.
load.quota.note: One message after a batch that ran out of browser storage; {ok} = files loaded, {no} = files not loaded.
load.space.files: «Free up space» panel: {n} = files loaded, {size} = space taken by their copies.
load.space.idx: «Free up space» panel: {size} = space taken by indexes and work files of the loaded files.
load.space.use: «Free up space» panel: {concesso} = space the browser grants the site, {usato} = space used (MB or GB already formatted).
load.space.rest: «Free up space» panel: {n} = removed files whose indexes remain, {size} = their size.
load.space.private: Notice of the «Free up space» panel when the quota is under 2 GB, typical of a private window; {concesso} = quota.
load.many.choose: Answer: bring them into the table unticked, the user ticks the ones to open.
